leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a helper function to check if a substring is a palindrome
Construct a recursive backtracking function to explore partition possibilities
Initialize and update a results array to store valid palindrome partitions
Manipulate string indices to generate substrings for palindrome validation
Integrate the palindrome checker with the backtracking algorithm
Apply the algorithm to partition sample strings into palindrome substrings
Configure the base case for the recursive function to terminate properly
